description: A sixteen-step sequencer with three rows of voltages and a gate for each step

params.text: Sets the speed of the internal clock, from about 15 to 3840 beats per minute
Starts and stops the sequence; it stays on the step it reached
Sends the sequence back to the first step
Sets how many of the sixteen steps play before the sequence starts over
Fires the gates for the step now showing, so a step can be tuned while the sequence is stopped
Moves the selected step back by one
Moves the selected step on by one
Chooses what the gate outputs do while a step plays: a 1ms trigger at the step, a gate that drops for 1ms at the step, or a gate held for the whole step
Sets the voltage that row sends while that step is playing, 0V to 10V
Turns the gate for that step on or off

inputs.text: Added to the CLOCK knob, a volt doubling the tempo
A clock patched here advances the sequence in place of the internal clock
A trigger here sends the sequence back to the first step
Added to the STEPS knob, a volt for each step

outputs.text: The gate for the step now playing, shaped by the gate mode switch
The voltage set for the step now playing by the knobs on that row
10V while that step is the one playing and its gate button is on, shaped by the gate mode switch

notes: The sequence runs on its own internal clock as soon as the module is added; a clock patched into the EXT CLK input takes over from it.
To tune a step, stop the sequence with RUN, move to the step with the minus and plus buttons, then press MANUAL TRIGGER to fire that step's gates while you set its row knobs.

inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
